ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) ratio across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive high-contrast black mottling (stippling) distributed across the entire visible surface. Contiguous white regions are concentrated in the lower central sections of both lobes, while dense, overlapping black blobs dominate the trailing edges and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible as a narrow V-shaped depression; however, the exact pixel angle is partially obscured by water turbulence at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge. Multiple jagged peaks and valleys (amplitudes of 5-15 pixels) are prominent, particularly on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe edges follow a distinct sigmoidal curve, exhibiting concavity near the central axis transitioning to a strong convexity toward the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous roughly circular black pixel clusters distributed along the trailing margin, suggesting sites of previous colonization or focal pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct dark linear mark is visible on the left lobe, oriented diagonally near the lower leading edge boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple parallel rake marks (linear disruptions) are visible on the left lobe surface; irregular pigmentation clusters are present along the serrated trailing margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'salt-and-pepper' pixel distribution across the entirety of the ventral surface, with exceptional density of small-scale black speckling.
